model_features: V1 FEATURES + ADJUSTED + ROTATION from challenger/run.py
embargo: Full intervening UTC day; no current-game player appearances
control: Frozen V1 candidate coefficients, recomputed on identical as-of base features and captured at the same timestamp as challenger, in a separate paired ledger; public V1 forecasts unchanged
history_2026: Allowed only for forward forecast state. Not evaluated, calibrated, fitted or used to choose a candidate.
capture: First verified pregame capture immutable, both model identities and features archived, never backfill after tipoff
grading: Same confirmed final identity and start; only pairs with both outcomes verified enter paired metrics
roster_fallback: Unknown until an earlier accepted rotation clears embargo; no preseason roster, transfer or injury inference
promotion: No automatic promotion. Review prospective paired evidence including accuracy, Brier, log loss, sample size and calibration; no fixed significance claim.
workflow: Six-hour research refresh; no change to public board
